description: This is a C# test file containing unit tests for Orleans grain factory mechanisms, including grain resolution, ambiguity handling, inheritance support, and various grain key usage scenarios.

classes.name: GrainFactoryTests
classes.description: Unit tests for verifying Orleans grain factory resolution and behavior across various scenarios, including ambiguity, inheritance, and key types.

methods.name: GetGrain_Ambiguous
methods.description: Tests that attempting to resolve a grain with ambiguous type mappings throws an ArgumentException.

methods.name: GetGrain_Ambiguous_WithDefault
methods.description: Verifies that Orleans resolves to the default grain implementation when multiple exist.

methods.name: GetGrain_WithFullName
methods.description: Tests resolving a grain via its fully qualified class name.

methods.name: GetGrain_WithPrefix
methods.description: Tests resolving a grain using a prefix string that matches the grain class name.

methods.name: GetGrain_AmbiguousPrefix
methods.description: Ensures that an ambiguous prefix results in an ArgumentException.

methods.name: GetGrain_WrongPrefix
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid prefix string causes an ArgumentException.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_NoPrefix
methods.description: Resolves a derived grain interface without using a prefix and verifies method outputs.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithFullName
methods.description: Resolves a derived grain using its full name and verifies method outputs.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithFullName_FromBase
methods.description: Accesses a derived grain via its base interface using full name resolution.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithPrefix
methods.description: Resolves a derived grain with a prefix and verifies method outputs.

methods.name: GetGrain_Derived_WithWrongPrefix
methods.description: Checks that an incorrect prefix when resolving a derived grain throws an exception.

methods.name: GetGrain_OneImplementation_NoPrefix
methods.description: Automatically resolves a grain when only one implementation exists.

methods.name: GetGrain_OneImplementation_Prefix
methods.description: Resolves a single-implementation grain explicitly using its full name.

methods.name: GetGrain_MultipleUnrelatedInterfaces
methods.description: Checks grains that implement multiple unrelated interfaces.

methods.name: GetStringGrain
methods.description: Resolves a grain with a string key and verifies behavior.

methods.name: GetGuidGrain
methods.description: Resolves a grain with a GUID key and verifies behavior.
